scope: Complete the one authorized t38 VCC upload by 02:00 Europe/Rome without routing the multi-GB product through the laptop
data: Only this T3 generated prediction, generation receipts, and the derived VCC archive
VCC_account_token: Stays in the local official CLI credential store; never transferred to Kaggle
runtime_capability: One official GCS resumable upload session URL for the single t38 entry. Kept outside Git and logs. It permits upload to that object only.
VCC_entry_creation: Only after source output is available and its producer, shape, effects, protocol and diagnostics have been verified
upload_gate: Full stage48 validation, container validation and bit-identical payload comparison before upload; GCS MD5 must match
scoring_gate: Local official CLI API launches scoring only after a verified cloud upload receipt
fallback_packaging: If source r5 saves completed cells after a packaging failure, package those exact cells on the large scratch disk, without refitting or regenerating
